certificate.native_object: for a smooth PDE carrier w=Q u the physical energy is ||w||_2^2=<u,Q^2u>; Q is an analysis operator and eta=Q^2 is its energy effect
certificate.hard_smooth_separation: hard orthogonal P is read only at an actual event; a smooth non-idempotent Q with QP=P is propagated between events and is completed by a square partition
certificate.quadratic_partition: positive self-adjoint smooth carriers satisfy sum_a A_a^2=I; this identity alone is analysis bookkeeping and does not make arbitrary dot A physical
certificate.resolved_repartition: with V fixed and h=u-V, the direct law splits exactly into low-low work, q^2-weighted HH work and native interface <u,dot eta u>-2 Re<eta u,L_Vu>; selected support kills low-low
certificate.outer_recombination: native smooth-interface work equals the work of (dot Q+[L_V,Q])u minus the diagonal L_V work of Q u; the commutator must not be interpreted alone
certificate.observer_gauge_quotient: before assigning physical relink ownership require one common skew generator G with dot A_a+[G,A_a]=0 for every smooth role; this is the transported affine/Kelvin observer motion and its energy work cancels exactly
certificate.physical_skew: write the actual skew resolved operator as K=G+K_phys only after the common transport identity is verified; K_phys has antisymmetric pair flux, zero total work and is the only smooth skew contribution eligible for physical relink ownership
certificate.symmetric: the S work rows are symmetric synthesis-pair strain work and sum to the same full resolved strain/deformation; no new source or Xi is created
certificate.forbidden_observer_motion: a time-dependent square partition whose motion is not generated by the certified common PDE transport cannot be Hahn-routed to a physical owner, even though its channel-energy changes sum to zero
certificate.forbidden_linear_complement: I-Q is not the energy complement of a non-idempotent Q; its skew defect is 4 Re<Q(I-Q)u,K u>; use Q^2+R^2=I instead
certificate.coefficient_reentry: a large Duhamel/interface coefficient impulse only locates a stopping interval; actual Q^2 carrier energy and gauge-quotiented native interface work reenter the physical-energy gate, and the impulse magnitude is never used as work
certificate.causal_route: the energy gate returns inheritance, high strain, actual q^2-weighted HH generation, or positive gauge-quotiented native interface work; only the last is Hahn-routed to physical relink provenance or existing strain, with exact ties joint
certificate.relation_to_donor_quotient: the smooth Q^2 theorem and hard event-role donor theorem share resolved K/S provenance but remain separately typed measures; no same-measure claim is made without a physical-work pushforward
certificate.scope: this closes the local smooth-envelope/projector algebra, observer-gauge quotient and coefficient-obstruction energy-reentry boundary; it does not prove global recurrence termination, UV closure or Navier-Stokes regularity
